rawFindings.title: Incorrect error assertion changed to no error expected
rawFindings.explanation: The test changed from expecting an error (assert.ok(err)) to expecting no error (assert.ifError(err)) which changes the intended test assertion behavior. If the tested scenario actually produces an error, this change hides the detection of that error, potentially masking bugs.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the change back to 'assert.ok(err);' unless the tested code has changed to correctly never produce errors in this case.
